dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. When did you first notice these changes in your balance and walking?

Well, it started about a week or two ago. My coworkers were the first to notice - they said I looked like I was stumbling around like I'd had too much to drink, even though I hadn't been drinking at all. It's been getting harder for me to walk straight.
Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or trouble focusing?
No, my vision has been fine - no double vision or anything like that. It's really just the walking and balance that's been the problem.
"Have you experienced any dizziness, ringing in your ears, or hearing loss alongside your balance issues?"
No, I haven't had any dizziness, ringing in my ears, or problems with my hearing. It's really just the coordination and balance when I'm trying to walk that's been off.
Have you had any trouble with your speech or experienced any difficulty swallowing recently?
No, my speech has been normal and I haven't had any trouble swallowing. It's really just been the walking and balance issues that have been bothering me.
Have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your arms or legs?

Actually, yes - now that you mention it, my right arm has felt a bit weaker than usual. I've noticed it's harder to do some things with that hand, like opening jars or carrying heavier items. But I haven't had any numbness or tingling.

RESULTS: MRI Brain shows lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). T1/T2 images demonstrate multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.
RESULTS: The requested JC virus PCR CSF test is not available in the current data. NORMAL READINGS.
RESULTS: The requested Serum JC virus antibody test is not available in the current data. NORMAL READINGS.
Got it. Have you recently taken any immunosuppressant medications or received any biologic therapies for a medical condition?
Yes, I've been on natalizumab for my Crohn disease for about a year now. My Crohn's was pretty severe and wasn't responding to the other treatments, so my gastroenterologist started me on that.
